description.value: Whenever a hostile creature within the emanation attempts a melee or ranged Strike against you directly, it must succeed at a Will save or the Strike is wasted outright — no attack roll made, no damage dealt, as though its nerve or its aim simply failed at the doorway. A creature only needs to attempt this save once per turn, no matter how many Strikes it tries. This effect ends immediately if you make an attack or use a hostile action against any creature. Doorways used to mean something. This is what's left of that.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 5: searched for a mechanism that negates an incoming Strike entirely, pre-damage, on a save (adjacent to the spell-deflection IWR type, which only applies to spells, and to Shield Block, which is hard-coded, not a rule element) -- found none in pf2e-source. Also self-cancelling on the caster's own hostile action, which compounds the gap: no rule element watches the caster's own subsequent actions either.
